claims.text: In-situ build-chamber preheating during SLM of high-entropy alloys reduces thermal gradients.
Reduced thermal gradients diminish residual stresses in SLM-fabricated high-entropy alloys.
Build-chamber preheating minimizes fabrication-induced defects in SLM-fabricated high-entropy alloys.
Build-chamber preheating improves the dimensional precision of SLM-fabricated high-entropy-alloy components.
Build-chamber preheating improves the mechanical integrity of SLM-fabricated high-entropy-alloy components.
High-entropy-alloy components can be fabricated by laser powder-bed fusion using mechanically alloyed powder without chamber preheating.
SLM-fabricated high-entropy-alloy components made under ambient, non-preheated chamber conditions typically exhibit residual thermal stresses.
SLM-fabricated high-entropy-alloy components made under ambient, non-preheated chamber conditions typically exhibit dimensional distortion.
SLM-fabricated high-entropy-alloy components made under ambient, non-preheated chamber conditions typically exhibit lack-of-fusion defects or porosity.
Preheating produces a more uniform thermal field during solidification.
A more uniform thermal field mitigates heterogeneous microstructural regions.
Build-chamber preheating slows the cooling rate during SLM.
Slower cooling promotes a more homogeneous microstructure.
The proposed thermal and microstructural changes reduce cracks, porosity, and distortion during layer-by-layer deposition.
Preheated SLM is expected to increase tensile strength and ductility relative to ambient-chamber SLM.
The effectiveness of chamber preheating depends on the alloy system and SLM parameters.
Alloys with extremely high melting points or sensitive phase behavior may require alloy-specific calibration of the preheat temperature.
Excessive chamber temperature may adversely affect powder flow.
Excessive chamber temperature may induce unwanted phase transformations.
The magnitude of improvement and its universality across different high-entropy-alloy compositions remain undetermined.
